title: Strict scaling from the scalability poset
literal:
Let $F=\{f_i\}_{i\in I}$ and $G=\{g_i\}_{i\in I}$ be unit-norm frames in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Suppose that $F$ and $G$ have the same scalability poset, and that $G$ is a tight frame. **Strict-scaling conjecture.** Then $F$ can be strictly scaled so that its factor poset is the same as the factor poset of $G$.

This conjecture is proposed as a possible structural basis for the open scaling problem stated immediately beforehand. The source gives no proof or resolution.
